Zalando’s Zalando Assistant team is looking for a Principal AI Scientist to help us build the future of retail through conversational AI experiences powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) and intelligent agents. Your expertise will be key in designing and developing AI-driven systems that support fashion discovery, trend exploration, outfit recommendations, and conversational shopping experiences.

As a Principal AI Scientist, you’ll play a significant role in shaping the architecture and capabilities of the Zalando Assistant. You will work on AI agents, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and LLM integrations, ensuring high-quality, grounded, and engaging conversations. Your domain will span the full customer lifecycle, helping drive customer activation, engagement, retention, and conversion through intelligent conversational experiences.

You will be at the center of fostering a culture of experimentation and innovation, ensuring assistant improvements are rigorously evaluated using both offline and online metrics. Your work will directly influence business impact, improving engagement, retention, and long-term customer value through conversational AI.

# Tallinn

Welcome to Tallinn, where Pipedrive was born.

Come and join Pipedrive’s Tallinn team!

See open positions

## About us

Pipedrive was born in Tallinn. What started as a small startup in a shared office has grown into an international company with an entire building in Tallinn’s vibrant WoHo quarter. Today, Tallinn is home to our engineering and product hub, where 300+ team members from 30+ nationalities work together – many of them engineers.

Pipedrive is proud to be Estonia’s fifth unicorn and has consistently been recognized as one of the best places in the country to work since 2016, according to both the media and our employees. And we’re not just about jobs – at Pipedrive, you’ll have the chance to grow, learn and make a real impact by helping shape a product used by more than 100,000 companies worldwide.

## Our traditions

At Pipedrive, we love to celebrate the moments that matter – from birthdays and work anniversaries to promotions. One of our most beloved traditions is getting together for *Kringle*, a classic Estonian pastry, though you’ll also see pizza, donuts or pancakes make an appearance. To make sure no celebration goes unnoticed, we’ve got a kitchen-alert Slack channel to keep everyone in the loop.

Our biggest annual event is the Summer Garage – a full-day celebration that brings teams together to connect, unwind and enjoy live music performed by our very own band (and sometimes a guest artist or two).

We also host occasional hackathons and innovation accelerators to spark new ideas for improving the product and how we work together.

We believe in a balance of fun and focus. From Lightning Talks where anyone can practice their presentation skills with a topic they care about, to Sudoku tournaments and gaming challenges organized by teammates, there’s always something to get involved in.

We’re also proud to contribute to the wider community: Our team actively supports the local engineering, product and HR scenes in Estonia by hosting in-house meetups, participating in conferences and speaking at events.

Staying active outside of work is also a big part of our culture. Whether it's a friendly game of table tennis, a disc golf match or a padel session – one of the most popular sports among our Tallinn team – there's always fun going on.

## Where you’ll find us

You’ll find us in Tallinn’s modern WoHo district, where our custom-designed office makes it easy to feel at home. Each of our eight themed floors – park, nature, sports, IT, music, art, movies and culture – is fully immersive. Whether you’re jamming on the music floor’s instruments or exploring the art gallery, there’s something for everyone.

The heart of the office is our all-hands area, where people gather for a coffee or something else from our well stocked kitchens. Welcome to Tartu, a vibrant student city where everything is within walking distance.

Come and join Pipedrive’s Tartu team!

## About us

Pipedrive’s Tartu office opened in 2015 and is now home to one of our four engineering hubs, along with Tallinn, Prague and Lisbon. With 60+ employees representing more than 10 nationalities, we’re a tight-knit team with big ideas and even bigger energy.

While Pipedrive has grown into Estonia’s fifth unicorn, the culture in Tartu still carries the spirit of our early startup days – where creativity, humor and collaboration lead the way.  
Sure, their jokes are hilarious, but don’t let that fool you: “Tartu delivers” is this office’s motto, for a reason. The winning teams at our hackathons often come from here and the quality of their work speaks for itself.

Over the years, we’ve been recognized with multiple best employer awards in Estonia, but what makes this office truly special is its people. Whether you're a seasoned engineer or just starting your career, you'll find the space and support you need to thrive here.

## Our traditions

We like to keep things down to earth and fun. Whether that’s sharing self-organized lunches, competing in a bake-off, or cheering each other on during a Lightning Talk (where employees get to hone their presentation skills on a topic of their choice), there’s always something happening.

Each month, we come together for different activities – from sauna nights, board game battles and gaming tournaments to hiking, biking and even winter swimming. We’ve got a strong gaming culture, a love for the outdoors and a great sense of humor that ties it all together.

We also host our own version of Pipehikes, inspired by our team in Lisbon, and open the office doors to our little ones during PipeKids – an annual afternoon of creativity and play for employees’ families.  
 And at the end of the year, we join Pipedrivers around the world for our winter holiday celebration: an in-house award show full of recognition, fun sketches and community spirit, dubbed “The Pipeys”.

Whether you're leading a talk, jumping into a tournament or just relaxing in the sauna, there’s a place for you here.

## Where you’ll find us

Our Tartu office is located near the city center in the city’s first LEED Gold-certified office building – a modern, energy-efficient tower that reflects our commitment to a thoughtful work environment. We occupy two cozy, creative floors, giving us plenty of natural light and sweeping views of the Emajõgi river.

One is inspired by video games – yes, we game a lot – while the other is themed around Estonian birds. If you’re curious, yes, we really do enjoy pronouncing names like Ööbik and Tuttpütt.

We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.

## **The Role**

AI has dramatically expanded who can build software inside Aiven. People across Finance, People, GTM and Marketing now turn operational problems into working applications much faster than before, and Product Development is starting to build too. Our engineering foundations need to catch up with that new way of working.

You'll own the engineering system for Aiven's internal applications: one foundation that makes building at this scale safe, maintainable and efficient, so applications are easy to maintain, merge and split as the business changes.

You'll prove it on real products. You'll directly own our hiring platform and the gateway that gives applications controlled access to our business systems, and use them to find what the shared layer gets wrong before everyone else depends on it. Then you'll help teams across the company move onto it.

You'll build on Aiven Runtime, our own product, as its demanding internal customer. What you learn running real applications on it goes back to the product teams.

As a Staff engineer, your impact is mostly outside your own team, and your leverage comes through influence rather than authority.

You'll join a small team responsible for the data, systems and internal software behind how Aiven operates, based at our Helsinki HQ. We work together in the office three days a week.

Within two months, you've got the first applications running in production on Aiven Runtime. Within six months, you've shipped the improvements our hiring platform and gateway need most and built what you learned into the shared layer, most of our actively developed applications run on the shared layer, and people across the business ship on it without waiting for you. Within a year, it's the default for everything new we build.

We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.

In automotive we build full platforms, from stock-car locators to configurators and more. Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Mindset

title: Veriff
content:
All open positions # Senior Software Engineer Function: Authentication & Identity Team: Authentication & Identity Location: Tallinn, Spain (Remote)
At Veriff's Biometric Solutions team, we are trying to prove, in real time, that the person on the other side of the screen is real and who they claim to be. Our ML-powered platform uses advanced image recognition, facial verification, face recognition, facial anti-spoofing (liveness detection), and behavior analysis to make identity decisions.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build and scale our real-time verification services, with security, scalability, and maintainability at the core.

You'll help us protect honest people online by:
  •  Owning the design and evolution of the architecture for a strategically critical product area, making the calls that shape scalability, security, and maintainability for years
  • Leading transformational architecture work: real-time matching at scale, resilient event-driven services, and the CI/CD and observability foundations that make them dependable
  • Setting and raising engineering standards, and mentoring and growing the engineers around you
  • Partnering closely with other engineers, ML data scientists, and specialists to turn complex identity problems into working products, and driving cross-functional alignment with product and dependency teams
  • Building scalable, maintainable APIs and event-driven services that other teams and external customers depend on
You are the right future Veriffian if you have
  • Over 5 years of experience building and operating large-scale applications (ideally in Python)
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, modular design, and SOLID principles, with a track record of architectural ownership
  • Experience building scalable, maintainable APIs and working with message-queuing concepts
  • Fluency with CI/CD, monitoring, and what it takes to run reliable, high-throughput services in production
  • Comfort with a range of testing strategies for robust, reliable software
  • A working understanding of relational databases and structured logging systems
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, able to align engineers and non-engineers around a technical vision
  • A self-starter mindset that balances both tech and product decisions to come up with a balanced outcome for both customers and engineers.
  • A history of mentoring engineers and explaining your solutions to non-engineers
Nice to have:
  • Some experience working with mobile SDKs (iOS, Android) or Web in React
  • Previous experience working on a B2B/SaaS product
You can explore our tech stack on
